reviews.t: The location, breakfast, and excellent service.
beautiful location and yummy complimentary breakfast! we loved the view from both our room and the dining area!

The view from the breakfast room is spectacular
The breakfast is very good with a large choice of very yummy food
They also offer dinner
Nice location and view from the cabin. Very nice breakfast spread .
Noice and clean

The young man at reception and serving us at dinner and breakfast was always smiling, kind, courteous and accommodating. He was able to get us squeezed in for dinner at the last minute even though we were a late arrival. This was going above and beyond! We appreciate it and will recommend your guesthouse to everyone! Plus the views at sunset were unbelievable!
Beautiful views, good breakfast, friendly staff. Nothing to complain :)
Nice place. Middle of nature with great view on the glacier! And on the sheeps ;)
The unique location on a farm with stunning views
Clean, spacious cabin with a beautiful view
Best breakfast with lamb Salami
Very clean. Good food for dinner as well. Quiet location.
Beautiful scenery and atmosphere. Dinner was good and convenient. Towel warmer in bathroom. Continental breakfast was great.

First of all, the guesthouse operator was amazing and very service-oriented—always smiling and ready to say "yes." The rooms were spacious, clean, and comfortable, though the mattresses were a bit too soft for my taste. The (optional) dinner was delicious and generous, and the breakfast was excellent as well. The views surrounding the property are breathtaking.
The location was great and the staff were very friendly. Breakfast was perfect.

Location perfect for those looking for peace and beautiful views. Even though bathroom is shared, there is a small sink in the room, which helps a lot.
Very good breakfast in the morning.
Breakfast buffet was wonderful. Rooms very comfortable and spacious.

Miglior sistemazione della nostra vacanza islandese. Immerso nella natura, bella sala da pranzo che si affaccia su campagna e in lontananza si intravedono con il bel tempo i ghiacciai, ottima colazione e ricca con prodotti locali, personale disponibile, stanza ampia. Abbiamo ricevuto anche un upgrade ottenendo una camera con bagno nonostante avessimo pagato per una camera con bagno condiviso. La strada sterrata per raggiungerlo può essere percorsa con qualsiasi auto. È possibile cenare presso la struttura: porzioni abbondanti e l'agnello del loro allevamento è il piatto forte della casa.
Great location and value for money
Million dollar view, good breakfast, comfortable and cozy! A memorable stay😁😁
The staff was very nice! The rooms were comfortable! We loved the option to eat homemade dinner as well as breakfast buffet.

Staff were friendly and hospitable
Views stunning
Dinner & breakfast outstanding and great value for money
Very comfortable, warm and quiet

I could not hype this place enough. It was wonderful!! In the middle of grassy planes with sheep grazing. Amazing views of the mountains that you could see even when in bed! Local Cousine with farm to table ingredients! Happy staff!! It was wonderful!! I could not recommend it enough!
Beautiful setting. Quiet. Comfortable beds. Amazing view from our window and from the dining room.
Great guesthouse, really kind and helpful stuff, breakfast was delicious with a good choice of food.

Great to come back to the accommodation.
A wonderful place to admire the landscape and the sounds of nature.
Very nice breakfast and staff, before and during the stay.
The area was quiet and we had a good night sleep. However, if you require hot water, you need to go to the reception to get some.
The size of the rooms and the views from each cabaign.
Everything
Breakfast was amazing with a decent size room and facilities

The room we rented was a double room in a shared house on the second floor. It was very spacious, with a beautiful view from the window, and the bathroom in the room was modern, very clean, and felt quite new.
The breakfast was also very good, with plenty of options to choose from, including boiled eggs, very tasty bread, butter, cheeses, sliced meats, and yoghurt with different toppings.

There are no words to describe the view from our room. We could see three glaciers! We were lucky enough to stay in one of the two separate wooden cottages (Room No. 8). It had windows on three sides, offering incredible views.
At the front (where you entered the room), there was a balcony where you could sit and relax, listening to the birds and enjoying the scenery. The breakfast was simple but satisfying.
Beautiful location. Windows looked out on glaciers and mountains. Wish I had more time here just to take in the beauty.
Located in a sheep farm. Very peaceful. Breakfast buffet has good options. Simple rooms.
It was a remote location but it was really worth it! The staff was very informative and welcoming.

Very nice big new room. Beautiful view of the glacier.
The staff is super helpful and nice. Breakfast is good with eggs, fruits, home made bread and cake. Also you have a tea station available any time.

This stay was amazing :). The personal is really nice, we stayed for 3 days here to discover properly the area. The views are amazing from this point and there is a lot of nature. It feels pure and it is a great experience we would recommend!
The breakfast was also great, and they also offer dinners!!
Excellent views of the glaciers all around. Friendly staff. Clean and comfortable room and shower, even a little small.
Home made bread made a difference in breakfast.

Beautiful location in a calm natural environment. You can see the glacier from the guest house. I booked a room with a shared bathroom: the room had a convenient small sink, the shower and toilet were in a separate shared bathroom. The bathroom was very clean, but I think it is unsufficient for the number of people that share it.
The restaurant offers some options for dinner if you don't want to drive to town and breakfast is rich and delicious
Beautiful, quiet location with exceptional views and perfect for northern light spotting due to low light pollution. Delicious dinners served.

The receptionist was very nice and propose to us to eat even when the kitchen was about to close. The room was a small lodge with everything needed and a little bit apart from the rest. Thank you very much
Quiet rooms, clean, adequate facilities

Good guesthouse near the main road, located next to the farm (so, you can smell it a little). Very friendly staff, rooms are pretty small, but have everything you need. Breakfast was also small, but had variety of local cheeses. Good value for money (we travelled in the spring, so I’m not sure how it’s during high season).
I booked a shared bathroom room but they gave us a private bathroom room instead, can’t complain!
Quiet location and clean. Staff was nice and accommodated our food needs.

The views were beautiful, wide open spaces, the northern lights, the mountains. The breakfast was wonderful and the staff as well. Close to many places on our list to visit. Comfortable beds and nice bathrooms.

Lovely guesthouse in the middle of nowhere.
After 5 days traveling we have finally been able to see the northern lights.
Great staff, they also gave me a lot of infos before arriving.
One of the best and cheapest place we have stayed
Stunning view from the restaurant.
Gorgeous views, comfortable bed and privacy.

The breakfast was good (although the coffee was just like water...). The restaurant of the hotel is also very nice! For dinner we chose lamb from their own farm, and it was excellent!!! It is quite juicy and tasty! You should never miss it!!! The staff was also very friendly:) The view outside the hotel was fantastic! We saw very beautiful sunrise:)
The breakfast and staff were superb. The views from the hotel were spectacular.
All good
Very cozy little guesthouse on a farm close to the ring road but far enough off for it to ve quiet and no lights so you can watch the aurora perfectly. Very friendly staff! Great breakfast selection.

Great accommodation in the middle of nowhere :). Very clean, warm rooms, the staff were really welcoming. We arrived around 19:30 and ate dinner in their restaurant. The menu is all lamb or vegetarian and very reasonably priced compared with most restaurants around.
Beautiful location, nice room and breakfast
Very accommodating host, lovely dinner & breakfast. Nice quiet location away from the crowds but not too far off Hofn either.
Small cottage was very nice, breakfast was great
Location is amazing ! Such beautiful scenery and sunrise and sunset was amazing ! Really great views

The guesthouse is adorable and the man working the front desk is so fun! Views are amazing!! It’s very rural and a completely different vibe than any place I’ve stayed before. Breakfast provided in the morning is nothing crazy but was good enough for us! The dinner is also more reasonably priced than other nearby restaurants.
The dinner was amazing!
Loved the place, it is a very nice location recommend it, the staff was amazing they even upgraded our room to one with the bathroom ensuite without charge. Very nice breakfast with lots to eat.

The location was amazing, right next to the glacier, yet still off the road, so we could feel the peace and quiet as well as see Northern lights. Breakfast was also great with many options. The room was bigger than expected and very nice.
Perfect remote guesthouse with local kitchen, very clean and comfortable rooms.
Excellent breakfast and an amazing lamb dinner. The staff were lovely. The off-the-beaten-path location gave the place a truly magical vibe.
The hosts were very friendly and helpful and the accommodations were nice and clean. Dinner and breakfast were really delicious!

The staff was really kind & nice!
The location was magical 🥰
Solid good value place in a beautiful setting. Good breakfast.
Great location and great view! We could see northern lights from our room!
The location of the accommodation was great as we were heading to the Diamond beach the following morning. There were also amazing views.
We loved the location for the closeness to the glacier and we were blessed to stay in one of the cabins with great views. We were very lucky to see the northern lights from our bedroom window
Awesome. We could see nithern lighs from our room. Close to the city and glacier but far enoygh from the lights. Love it!

Great location for the northern lights and if you want to stay between Vik and Hofn. The farm is quite remote, a couple of KM’s along a dirt road but northing problematic. Great value food - try the lamb burger! Breakfast was good too.

A wonderful place. A beautifully situated farm with animals. Far enough away from the city lights to effectively observe and photograph the aurora borealis. Our room was upstairs in the house. We had our own bathroom. It was cozy and warm. The room and bathroom were equipped with everything we needed. The property offers dinner and breakfast. Breakfast included meats, skyr, cheeses, eggs, cakes, caviar spread, vegetables, bread, and much more. The best part was that they also offered homemade products, such as lamb carpaccio. There's no kettle in the room, but there's hot water and coffee in the common areas. Very clean. The receptionist was very friendly and helpful. The road to the property is good. We saw reindeer on our way out of the farm. One of the best accommodations in Iceland. We will definitely return. On a scale of 1 to 10, I'd give a 20.
We arrived super late, but the key was left for us at the reception. The room was spacious, the bathroom was clean, breakfast was convenient. Location is good, quite close to the glacier lagoon.

Lovely remote accommodation with attentive welcoming staff. Arrived just as the restaurant was about to close but offered dinner without any fuss. The food was hot and freshly cooked and very welcome after long day. The room was simple, warm and comfortable with extensive countryside views.
Good selection at breakfast with warm homemade bread readily replenished. Would definitely recommend

We instead stayed in the Standard Bungalow room. This stay was outstanding and very memorable, the staff were lovely and helped us celebrate a special occasion. The bungalow was very cozy, quiet, and had a great view of the glacier in the far off distance. We even saw the Aurora Borealis outside our window and went outside for a few hours just to watch it dance above us. I wish we could've stayed longer. Breakfast was busy but great.
Coziness and space , and the dinner
Amazing stay with the northern lights and fabulous breakfast ☺️
Very nice breakfast, gorgeous surroundings, very clean rooms.

Everything. Going inside was a nice surprise to see how well treated was the place. Great rooms, great breakfast, everything was clean. Close to Hofn, but not so much, it's great to see Auroras! I really enjoyed my stay.
Loved the location, the room, the coziness, the breakfast!

Amazing location in the middle of nowhere, in the morning we could see the sun rising on the sea and the moon peaking from behind the mountains. Very picturesque!! The price is amazing for a clean (!) room with private bathroom, breakfast buffet included. We got there late (around 8pm) but just in time to eat dinner and the food was delicious as well (not included in the price but worth it). We also briefly saw the aurora!

Had a great stay! The room was clean, quiet, and just right for one person. Loved the peaceful farm setting — super relaxing. The dinner and breakfast were both delicious and made with fresh local ingredients, which made the stay even better. The host was really friendly too. Would definitely stay again!
Very clean and friendly. If you eat dinner get the lamb, it was amazing.

Everything was just perfect! The staff were super friendly, the food was amazing, and the place itself was beautiful. Loved the peaceful atmosphere and the stunning views. Couldn’t have asked for a better stay – highly recommend!

We have now stayed at Nypugardar 3 times in the last 9 years. We keep coming back, and will continue to do so. This is an exceptional farm stay, with a dining room (great views!) and breakfast included. We always stay for 2 nights or more. It was one of our first bookings on our most recent circumnavigation, and one reason was the dinner on offer and the farm-produced roast lamb on the menu. Things change in Iceland, not always for the better, but Nypugardar delivers the same exceptional stay, and OMG, our roast lamb dinner actually exceeded our expectations - just delicious and HUGE serving. We will definitely be staying there again next time we are in Iceland, focusing on the north east coast. We cannot rate Nypugardar high enough!
It was not far from route 1 but was surrounded by peaceful countryside.
Nice, helpful staff.. Reasonably priced for dinner with stay in breakfast 😋 ☺️
The guesthouse was clean, staff was friendly and the breakfast was really nice with amazing view. Truly value for money!
I absolutely lived the location...very picturesque and we saw the Northern lights!
Spacious and clean rooms. Accomodating staff. Really good breakfast spread. Bonus - great location away from the town to see the Northern lights.

We stayed in a separate building from the main house. The room was clean and comfortable with a fantastic view. The Northern Lights are awesome here. We also had a view of several glaciers. All from our terrace. We had dinner at the Guesthouse. Per several reviews, the menu was limited, but I wouldn't expect anything else as they are basically serving only their guests. We had the lamb burger ultra and the lamb. The price was very reasonable and both were outstanding! The breakfast included fantastic skyr along with meats and cheeses.

A very nice place, clean, comfortable bed, good breakfast. Nice hosts, we didn't know if we would arrive because there were problems with the road due to heavy rains and they offered to refund our money. But we arrived and felt very good, for dinner we had the best lamb. Thank you!
The location is so nice and peaceful. The staff is very friendly and it meets all of your needs. Great place to see the Northern Lights too!

The Guesthouse Nýpurgarðar is located on a sheep farm in a certain way in the middle of nowhere. The views from the property are beautiful. Note that to get there, you have to drive 3 km on a gravel road. The rooms are very basic but clean. They offer a breakfast buffet, but they start a little late. Since we had an early morning tour, after our request the previous evening they prepared a bag with food to take with us, including 2 sandwiches, 1 apple, 1 orange, and 2 sweet breads, which were very helpful and we appreciated.
In my opinion, the room was somewhat expensive for what we expected, compared with some other hotels we stayed in in our trip.
Stayed in a cabin away from the main building. Room and bathroom were large and comfortable. Breakfast was okay and dinner there had a limited choice but was tasty. Fantastic view from our cabin.
Nice location, very basic room. O k for a 1 night stopover. Good food,.

The included breakfast was wonderful. The views all around were lovely as was the sound of the sheep. Dinner was good. It was nice to be able to eat there since town was a little ways away. Excellent Lamb and Lamb burgers.
The best lamb dinner meal I have ever had. Very friendly staff. Breakfast was great. Beautiful property and views.
Beautiful view, friendly staff, very quiet and calming. Room was clean but basic. Comfy beds Both dinner and breakfast were very good.
Very good breakfast.
A farm room with beautiful views and quiet location.
Nice place to stay in. Staff is friendly and breakfast is good
Quiet retreat relatively close to our outings for the day. Good breakfast
Great location, room was very spacious! Spectacular views as well!
Great location, very good breakfast. Nice view from window, quit remote.
Stunning view, comfortable room, excellent staff! Breakfast was also great.
A really nice guest house in the perfect spot for the ring road. The room is very clean and the breakfast is super. It is a perfect choice if you want to stay near Hofn.
Beautiful place, own bathroom, good breakfest, the place also offered dinner which we didnt have.
Staff was great and very helpful. Good location to see Jokulsarlon and Stokksnes.
Wonderful place
Location in a quite area around 3kms off the Ring Road. Staff was super friendly and the breakfast was great, so we had a convenient start to a long day ahead.
The views are phenomenal, the room was very clean.

Incredible views from all sides of the property. It was easy to find and the bed was perfect to sink into after a long day. Dinner was delicious - some of the best lamb we have ever had. All in all a wonderful atmosphere and place to stay

We had a nice stay and dinner at this farm. Excellent breakfast! The room was comfortable and clean. I believe the view would be majestic if only we had better weather as the edges of the glaciers were peeking out under the clouds. The host was very kind and attentive. Favorable price (for Iceland).

This place is amazing, very quiet and peaceful with nice views. We had a room with a private bathroom, and the room itself was quite spacious. The breakfast was great, including fresh and domestic food.

Very clean room and good breakfast. Also you could see the glacier from the Window.
The receptionist recommended a hicking trip near the glaciar. I was beautiful.
It was excellent value for the money. Breakfast and dinner were very nice. The views were absolutely amazing.
Friendly personal, very nice breakfast and dinner if you want it. Very warm and clean. There is a sink in a room which is great.
Great rooms. Specious and private. Nice breakfast. Sweet helpful staff.
Incredible views from the guesthouse, great dinner and breakfast
Very nice rooms and the staff was really nice.

The house is set in a beautiful landscape.
Great variety of food for breakfast (buffet style).
Clean room, breakfast adequate with fresh fruit available. USB charging by the bedside. Staff friendly
Nice view. No contact check-in.

We ate there for dinner aswell. One of the best lamb dishes i ever had!
The Soup was very good too.

Really nice guesthouse close to Höfn, very clean and comfy!
Sheeps are roaming around in front of your window which is super lovely!
Great view

Very nice location of the guesthouse,we received an upgrade what is very appreciated!Breakfast fresh with variety of food,more than expected!Staff was very helpful and nice,let us even to fulfill the thermos with hot water
Such a beautiful location; surrounded by nature, breakfast was great for the morning

- beautiful location of the house (seeing the sheeps from the bed)
- delicous dinner (recommendation their lamb)
- big room for one night
- comfy designed
- friendly personnel
Very good breakfast, amazing view from this place, hospitality :)
Beautyfull guesthouse placed at the farm. You can enjoy nature and the environment, watch aurora (if you're lucky)... Breakfast was such a delicious and plentiful!
The location was stunning and the guesthouse was very inviting and comfortable. The staff has been very kind and tried to accommodate all our requests. Definitely recommended.

Clean and spacious guesthouse located on the most gorgeous farm. We stayed in one of the rooms separate from the main house and had the most beautiful views of the glaciers right from our bed. The room and bathroom were very large and clean. Very picturesque and quiet with adorable sheep nearby. Breakfast is in the main house that has windows overlooking the coast like and glaciers. Stunning!
Very comfy rooms. Lovely location. Super handy that they served us dinner when we were exhausted after a day out and didn't want to leave the premises.
Experience very beautiful aurora borealis dancing in front of the balcony
Clean, comfortable, great blackout curtains and friendly staff
Complementary breakfast, flexible check-in! Very friendly hosts! Comfy beds. If we do Iceland's ring road ever again, we're definitely coming back here!

Our stay was amazing. Super clean and warm. The people who work there are very nice and friendly. The surrounding is stunning, amazing views in all directions. Cute sheeps around. Breakfast very nice, frash tasty bread and cheese. Also very delicious and not too expensive dinner. Highly recommend to stay here!
Staff were really friendly and helpful. Fantastic restaurant at fair prices. Lamb from the local farm. Beautiful rooms in a picturesque rural location

This was our second time there.
Location is very good, located on nice farm with lot of animals.
Breakfast is standard offering for Iceland and it is just fine.

Beautiful scenery, friendly personnel and great food for a good price. The breakfast was also really nice and the view from our cabin was amazing. There is a long gravel road to get there (doable with 2wd), but it was definitely worth it!
The included breakfast is great and the room was also spacious.
Confortable place. Spectacular view from the guesthouse. The farm with the sheeps newly born
A perfectly quaint little hotel in the mountains. Check in was a breeze. Beds were comfy. Delicious traditional Icelandic breakfast. The drive up was super cute. Lots of sheep and birds.

Excellent breakfast
Glacier view from here

The location is nice - very quiet and peaceful. The guesthouse is easy to find. The hosts are very flexible with check-in. We arrived late in the evening (around 9/10 pm) and they left us our keys to our rooms at the reception and we paid for our rooms in the morning. The rooms were spacious and clean, we had a private bathroom. Breakfast was delicious and there was a lot of options to choose from. They also offer an additional dinner.
Location. Dinner amazing!! Good bathtub with warm water outside the building.

We had a great stay here, the breakfast was great and the location was right next to a farm, so its a nice stay away from the busy city life. For breakfast they even have freshly baked bread, and I tried a salmon spread I really liked.
It was so worth it to book a room with our own bathroom, we felt like we could get ready at our own pace.

We booked a small room in the house. It was small but plenty of room for two and had a little sink in it for brushing teeth and such. The breakfast was really excellent! The setting is out in the middle of nature next to a farm. We saw some newborn lambs the morning we were there in the end of April.

This place is amazing and very clean. Both breakfast and dinner were great. For dinner, we had the local lamb burger, and the portion was really big — definitely worth every penny! We had a room with a private bathroom, and the room itself was quite spacious. The highlight of our stay was seeing the most beautiful Aurora right from our room. It was also very windy during our stay, so we got to experience the real Icelandic wind.
We will definitely be back to this place!

Oh my gosh where do I even begin! This guesthouse was an absolute delight to stay at and thank god we had it for 2 nights! We were booked in one of their cabins overlooking a field and the mountains and it was just a dream. We would wake up to birds in the field chatting away and get to see the beautiful sunrise on the horizon and on the mountains. The location was beautiful with 360 uninterrupted sights. Their dining room is full of windows so every breakfast and dinner you can see the beautiful landscape while you eat. The cabin was easy to keep warm, very well insulated, and very roomy and cozy. We sat on the porch most mornings and evenings just taking it in. The staff were friendly and spoke english. The complimentary breakfast buffet was delicious and food was plentiful. Highly, highly recommend and will 100% come back again in the future.
Nice view from the terrace, a tasty lamb burger for dinner.
amazing views and good breakfast.

It was a great stop for us ! The room and bathroom were very spacious (we had such a great view too). The included breakfast was also great, lots of options sweet and savory, as a vegan I appreciated the bread, jam, fruits and almond milk. Highly recommend

The place was very nice and clean, a bit too warm.
As the dinner was higly recommended, we were looking forward to it. We texted the accommodation asking when are they serving it, which is 7 p.m. and they advised us to go no later than 7:30 p.m. as it might have higher demand depending on how many people are staying. Since there was a slight chance we would arrive few minutes after 7:30, we requested information whether there are a lot of people and if we could still be served - no one responded. We arrived somewhere between 7:40 and 8 p.m. and the girl informed us the dinner was UNTIL 7:30 p.m. (so served only between 7 and 7:30 p.m.; there was just one couple in the cantine). There was no place we could eat proper meal which was a bit diasappointing, as the girl could have responded earlier and we could have then prepared better.

The Staff was absoutely amazing, we also used the option to have dinner there and their lamb dishes were exceptional. We had small cottage below the main area and were completely alone. It was the best accomodation during our stay.
Perfect location to view the northern lights

Very nice location with great view and really good breakfast. The personnel was really nice.
Thank you !

Gorgeous location with incredible views, very good room and bathroom. Delicious breakfast which was a really nice addition to the stay and super good value being included in the price of the room!
Room was very hot with no radiator to change and temp/ window did not open very wide!
Not the fault of the property however the road leading up the property is extremely bumpy/ pot holey gravel track!
Great rural location, you can see the sheep and the sheds. Nice, luminous dining area, a porch with great views. Clean, spacious cabins with built-in bathrooms. Clean linen and towels. Friendly staff
An incredible guesthouse, with a very welcoming staff, with a view to the tongues of the vanajokull glacier, spectacular, perfect as well to see the northern lights

+Fantastic and amazing location surrounded by amazing landscapes 360 degrees. We could have a fantastic view of vesterhorn, heinaberg glacier from here
+ common toilet and bathroom were very clean and well maintained
+ Breakfast was excellent and the the breakfast eating area is with a fantastic view
+ paid dinner option was excellent . We get to taste the lamb meat from their own farm. It was fantastic.
+Fantastic and lovely place to view the northern lights .

The location is great, remote and with fantastic views. It's next to a farm which some people won't like but for us, it made it more rural and added to the experience. The staff were super friendly and attentive. Overall it's just a lovely place.
The location. Perfect for northern lights Soundproof rooms.
Great breakfast, also serve a great dinner!

It was away from city lights so we got to se the Northern lights from the hotel bedroom.
Good breakfast.
Food!! The breakfast bread is just amazing!
Complimentary breakfast. Quiet, and peaceful area. Clean and up to date rooms.

I really liked this place, it is very nice and quiet with amazing views of the glaciers, the mountains and the sea. The staff was very kind and helpful and the rooms were clean and comfy. There is no kitchen but you can use the toaster in the dinning room area. We had dinner there, the lamb was very good, directly from their farm. Also it was good quality for the price we paid for the dinner compared to other restaurants. I recommend this place in your visit to Iceland for a road trip.

Wonderful stay! We had booked a room and were pleasantly surprised. It looked even better in real life than in the photos.
You could enjoy stunning views over the landscapes, even from your room. We were lucky to witness the beautiful Northern Lights from here.
The room was clean, and the breakfast was delicious! Definitely a must-add to your road trip.
Such a beautiful location, excellent facilities and great food. We saw auroras too!

The family cabin for four was very nice, spacious, clean
Breakfast was good
We were lucky to see the polar lights from a little hill just outside the main building
Dinner with lamb was absolutely wonderful!
We got an upgraded room with private bathroom, which was very nice. The breakfast was included in the price.
Had the lamb dinner and it was some of the best lamb I've ever had!

Spacious room which was nice and warm. Good value for money.
Basic breakfast however bread was 10/10!!!

The property was clean, comfortable and well situated. If it wasn’t cloudy it would be perfect for viewing northern lights as it is well away from artificial lights. I also liked that breakfast was included! The staff were very friendly.
I loved everything. Best one we seen in Iceland. Clean, warm, awesome location, great breakfast, super nice staff
We had a great experience, everything was excelent

Guesthouse Nýpugarðar is a very nice place to spend the night. The room had a beautiful view, and all the basic comforts were provided. The breakfast was very good, and the location is very convenient for exploring the area. Simple, easy, and perfect for a relaxing stay.
Nice place surrounded by beautiful nature, peace and quiet. Room is comfortable and facilities are clean. Good breakfast and dinner options.

Nice stuff, made us a late dinner, and hosted us with such a friendlyness. We had a pretty small room, which is difficult to put 2 big suitcases in, but it worked out fine. There are some bigger rooms as well. You have a sink & a mirror within the bedroom, so you don't have to brush your teeth in the public bathroom.

Great dinner. Wonderful breakfast. We had two rooms. Had problems locking the doors. Our daughters’ door flew open due to wind. When they notified the management the next morning, they said “we know “.
Quiet
Excelente lugar!
Everyone was so nice here! All the staff made us feel very welcome. The rooms were nice and cozy. And the complementary breakfast and the paid dinner were exceptionally delicious!

The guesthouse is on a sheep farm in a rural area about halfway between Jokulsarlon and Hofn. It was a perfect location for the ice cave/glacier tour and beautiful for viewing norther lights at night! The breakfast is very filling with fresh breads, meat, cheese, fruit and yogurt. Our room with private bathroom was located in a row of small cottages outside the main guesthouse. It was very comfortable, quiet and spacious.
Amazing isolated place for northern lights and peace and beautiful views

The host is simply amazing!
Great breakfast and clean room
In the middle of nowhere, staff lovely, breakfast inc which was good and was lovely
The staff is very kind, I was attended by a girl a she gave us a nice service, the food (lamb of its farm) is awesome, the dessert, absolutely delicious. I recommend to try them.

Amazing location for aurora
Cozy rooms
Good dinner with fair prices
It was good as described

I have a very nice experience there. The staff was lovely and the room as well. We decided to have dinner there and it was delicious. We couldn't have breakfast because we needed to leave early and the staff prepare us a take away breakfast. Very helpful!!
We also saw the strongest Northern lights!! We could see them from our bedroom window.
Amazing experience!
The location was great, the room lovely and the breakfast was good.
A lovely clean place to stay, very cozy, loved the food menu, the soup was amazing!
This very pleasant accommodation is located in the middle of a sheep farm. There are several buildings with comfortable, spacious and clean rooms. The breakfast was very plentiful and delicious.
perfect guest house! specious room! Beautiful view from the hotel!
Good breakfast, laundry service
Friendly staff (and owner?) - free hot water for take away. Many thanks to Misha for kideness and being so nice and helpfull!
The room was an excellent value and the guesthouse is in an amazing, rural area. Overall, with the breakfast included, the room is a very good option for lodging in the area.
The breakfast was good, their dinner portions are huge and delicious. The atmosphere is great and the hosts are very nice and welcoming. The aurora was visible from the house.
The location, amazing food and not expensive
Super well located. The staff is fantastic. I informed we would be leaving early, before the breakfast being served, they prepared a small breakfast meal for take away for us. Very kind of them.

The staff were very friendly, the entire place was very clean and tidy. The rooms were small but good for one night. Breakfast was average but we had a very delicious dinner for a fantastic price. I would stay again.
Its location and neatness and good breakfast

Guesthouse je umístěn v krásném prostředí pobřežní roviny s 360° výhledem na nejbližší hory z masivu Vatnajökull. Je malý, ale vkusně zařízen, měli jsme v hlavní budově malý pokoj s koupelnou jehož zařízení vypadalo nově. Strávili jsme zde sice jen jednu noc, ale prostředí i neformální atmosféra se nám líbila. Ubytovali jsme se zde po dlouhém přejezdu z východních fjordů, takže nám příšla vhod nabídka večeře od 19 hodin. Večeře nabízená v místní jídelně byla skvělá s jídly za velmi přátelské ceny. Výběr jídel byl omezenější, ale dali jsme si vynikající pečené jehněčí se zeleninou (obrovskou porci) a velký jehněčí burger, oboje s hranolkami. Porce byly obrovské a k tomu jsme ještě ochutnali typickou rajčatovou polévku a jako dezert čokoládový fondán se skyr zmrzlinou stracciatella. Za dvě jídla, jednu polévku, jeden dezert a pití jsme zaplatili méně než 6,000 ISK za osobu. Snídaně byla v ceně ubytování, byla klasická, ale s výběrem sýrů, uzenin, domácího chleba a samozřejmě jogurtů.
Hotel je výhodně umístěn jen asi 3 km od hlavní cesty, takže po večeři jsme ještě zajeli k laguně Jökulsárlón a Diamond Beach, kvůli fotografování při večerním světle. Jízda k laguně od hotelu trvá jen asi 45 minut, což je skoro o polovinu kratší než přímo z Höfn, vraceli jsme se po půlnoci za plného světla.

住宿提供的早餐很好吃，員工也很友善，以後有機會會再選擇這裡入住！

Personale molto cordiale, stanza super comoda e bagno molto pulito. Colazione molto buona e ottima anche la cena, prezzi competitivi per l'Islanda. Posizione ottima, isolata e senza inquinamento luminoso: abbiamo visto l'aurora boreale più bella dell'intero viaggio!
Práchtig uitzicht vanuit de eetruimte, waar altijd koffie en thee klaarstaat. Heerlijk ontbijt met verse producten. Ook het avondeten was erg smaakvol. Wij hebben genoten!

Das Frühstück war ein tolles Buffet und der Lammbraten am Abend war grandios.
Für die Beobachtungen der Nordlichter war die abgelegene Lage ausgezeichnet.

Ich hatte eine der Hütten, die war sehr geräumig.
Bei gutem Wetter hat man von dort einen Superausblick auf die Berge. Ich bin Wiederholungstäter und werde sicher auch wiederkommen. Das Frühstück ist gut und man kann dort auch ein gutes Abendessen bekommen.

C etait vraiment top !
Nous sommes arrivées le soir et avons pu manger au restaurant : C erait délicieux ! Une soupe a la tomate et de l agneau, vraiment délicieux !
La chambre etait tres grande !
Et la guesthouse est bien placée
Nous acons vu un superbe lever de soleil le matin !
Le logement est très bien placé, la chambre et salle de bain sont très biens. Les plats proposés et le petit déjeuner sont très bons et le tarif est raisonnable.
todo muy agradable
Posto a conduzione famigliare, staff gentilissimo e ottima cucina (a cena prendete l'agnello, della loro fattoria: super)
Tout ! Très bien, très beau, personnel génial, très amical et surtout très gentil !
Buona la cena, consiglio di farla, agnello loro wow. Bella la colazione, pane fresco e prodotti freschi.
L'accueil, le personnel, le déjeuner

Het is een rustig gelegen accomodatie. Wij hadden de Cabin met mooievergezichten geboekt. Faciliteiten zijn erg basic, maar een goed bed en warme douche zijn het belangrijkste. Daarnaast kun je er heerlijk en betaalbaar eten en ook ontbijt was uitgebreid en erg lekker.
Emplacement au top et personnel très accueillant
Süsse kleine Häuschen, freundliches Personal, tolle Lage

Sehr freundliches Personal. Das Frühstück war super (Wurst, Käse, Skyr, Obst, Marmelade, Kuchen u.v.m ). Da es weit und breit kein Restaurant gibt, haben wir das Angebot eines "Dinners" zu einem angemessenen Preis sehr geschätzt. Dann war es auch noch richtig gut.
Warm, cozy place

Chambres confortables et agréables.
Petit déjeuner copieux en buffet et qui permet de découvrir des produits locaux en sucré et en salé.
Avons pris un diner, très bon et à prix correct pour l'Islande (un plat copieux et un dessert pour un peu moins de 40 euros).
Bien placé pour visiter un peu l'est (y avons vu des rennes sauvages proches de la route).
Un serveur souriant et très sympathique

Wat een prettige omgeving, een prima accomodatie en een prima keuken.
Je kunt s avonds voor een prima bedrag heerlijk eten en daar werd ook goed gebruik van gemaakt want alle tafels waren bezet. Ook het ontbijt (inbegrepen in de prijs) was goed.
Wat een uitzichten! Heerlijk ontbijt en diner.
Ontwaken met een prachtig zicht op de gletsjers. Uitgebreid ontbijt!
Bellissimo panorama sul ghiacciaio! Colazione molto buona. Staff gentile.
Lo que era en la habitación estaba bien, la cama era cómoda y tenía un ventanal muy grande con vistas al glaciar.
El camarero español que nos recibió fue súper simpático. El sitio es increíble y las habitaciones están muy bien. La calefacción y las duchas funcionan muy bien también.
O Pequeno almoço é razoável, a localização é longe de tudo, até da estrada principal

La instalaciones son muy cómodas el baño muy limpio. La cabaña está situada frente a un establo y se escuchan los borregos. La vista es muy hermosa desde el restaurante. El desayuno muy delicioso. Me encantó el pan. También nos encantó que tienes opción de cenar en el restaurante para manejar hacia otro lugar.La sopa de tomate 10 de 10
Posizione bellissima in mezzo ad un magnifico paesaggio, personale gentile, silenzio, possibilità di vedere l'aurora boreale per l'assenza di luci, ottima colazione. Vicinanza a Hofn...da visitare!
Wir hatten eine Tour gebucht und mussten bereits um 7:30 das Guesthouse verlassen. Frühstück gab es aber erst ab 8:00 Uhr. Deshalb hat uns das Personal eine Frühstückssack to go zusammengestellt.

Sauber
Freundlich und gemütlich

Tout était très propre, confortable et accueillant dans cette guesthouse.
Le repas proposer le soir est simple et dans les prix du pays (Compter entre 2000kr et 3000kr pour un plat).
Le buffet du petit déjeuné est simple mais bon et efficace, et c’est agréable d’avoir le petit déjeuné compris dans le prix.
Pequeno almoço e comodidades
La nourriture était vraiment très bonne. L’emplacement est très calme.

Le lieu isolé, la vue extraordinaire sur les glaciers.
Le petit déjeuner est complet et copieux.
La literie est confortable.
Le repas du soir en supplément est très bon, je vous le conseil, des hamburger à base de moutons de leurs ferme, et un plat d'agneau excellent !

Adorei! Hotel situado numa zona super calma e tranquila. Funcionários super simpáticos e prestáveis. Tivemos um percalço com o nosso carro e ajudaram-nos sem hesitar!
O nosso quarto ficava numa zona à parte do edifício principal e era enorme :)
Immersa nel nulla, purtroppo abbiamo preso brutto tempo ma sarebbe stata perfetta per vedere l’aurora. Pochi ospiti e prezzi buoni al ristorante
Struttura molto accogliente, stanza spaziosa. La host molto gentile. Abbiamo utilizzato il servizio cena, piatti buoni e prezzi onesti e anche la colazione l’abbiamo trovata molto buona.

Bellissimo posto. Noi abbiamo alloggiato nel cottage. Serata stupenda direttamente dal letto abbiamo visto l’aurora….ottima colazione. La sera abbiamo cenato presso il loro ristorante. Abbiamo preso la zuppa del giorno e hamburger con patatine. Tutto ottimo anche il prezzo per essere Islanda.

Posizione ideale ,personale super cortese e disponibile. Siamo rimasti bloccati a causa del forte vento e non hanno avuto problemi a farci pernottare una notte in più senza dover cambiare nemmeno camera . Super consigliato!

Camera molto spaziosa e colazione sufficiente, non mancava nulla, dal dolce al salato. Ho apprezzato la possibilità di bere qualcosa di caldo anche la sera. Personale cordiale e posizione davvero bella. Facilmente raggiungibile anche con la neve.
Camere pulite, ottima colazione, letti comodi e ristorante utile (non eccellente ma unica soluzione per mangiare)
O jantar e o pequeno-almoço do alojamento são muito bons e com preços acessíveis.
晚餐鳕鱼和羊肉都很好吃！早餐也很棒！
Comodità, pulizia, posizione, possibilità di cenare, ottima colazione

Sitio muy diferente, alejado del ruido, en una granja! El staff súper amable, nos tomamos infusión riquisima y el desayuno era perfecto, pequeño pero con todo lo justo! Incluido gluten free bread que nos compraron para nosotros
Personel, lokalizacja
Tolles kleines Cottage mit sehr bequemen Betten, tolles Frühstück und Restaurant am Abend
Quarto limpo e confortável. Bom pequeno almoço. É possível jantar nesta guest house, o que é uma mais valia uma vez que fica afastada da cidade.
Camera accogliente e pulita. Colazione buona e altrettanto la cena presso il loro ristorante!
Место, чистота, хороший завтрак
Schönes, gut gelegenes Guesthouse. Das Abendessen im Restaurant war super und hat sich auf jeden Fall gelohnt. Auch das Frühstück war sehr gut.
农场相比于小镇，远离光污染，适合看极光，当晚我们也看到了美丽的极光，因为农场自己放羊，会有一点味道，介意的慎入，没有厨房，农场可以点晚餐，早上有免费的早饭，就是肉有点咸

- Wir haben ein Upgrade bekommen, also haben wir ein Zimmer mit eigenem Bad im Nebengebäude bekommen
- die Möglichkeit, warmes Essen zu guten Preisen abends zu bestellen (Schafsfarm)
- super bequeme Betten
Le meilleur endroit du séjour , directement à la ferme, à taille humaine et au milieu d’un paysage somptueux
La vista, las cabañas cómodas, vimos auroras, todo estuvo hermoso, buen desayuno
Struttura stupenda

Camera essenziale ma pulita e calda.
Vista sul ghiacciaio, circondata dal silenzio e dagli animali.
Posto stupendo!

Top Lage, super ruhig gelegen.
Sehr gutes Lamm zum Abendessen.
Frühstück ebenfalls ausgezeichnet.
Hotel situato in una zona isolata comodo per vedere aurora boreale direttamente dalla camera. Ci è stato fatto un upgrade graditissimo. Personale accogliente, colazione ottima e cena apprezzata.
Struttura in mezzo al nulla. Camera pulita, colazione inclusa. Possibilità di vedere l’aurora.
Fijne kamers, goede service, heerlijk ontbijt en goed diner aanbod!
El desayuno y la cena. La habitación con baño muy buena.

Muy familiar y tranquilo

Prachtig gelegen guesthouse, met 3,5 kilometer ietsje verder gelrgen van dr ringweg en daardoor ook heel rustig. Mooi ingerichte ruime kamer met heel goede badkamer
平價但卻相當好的住宿，加購的晚餐烤羊肉排相當美味，並非每個房間均有衛生間，但不影響住宿體驗，非常推薦。
Hermosas vistas a las auroras boreales durante nuestra estancia.
Tutte le richieste particolari sono state esaudite in modo impeccabile, la camera era bellissima anche con il bagno incluso. Casetta tranquilla e perfetta per il pernottamento.

Buen lugar para ver auroras.
Buena cena en el restaurante. De pago, pero buen precio (para ser Islandia).
Desayuno incluido, bastante variedad
Personal amable

Guesthouse a pochi km dalla strada principale, facilmente percorribile anche con neve. Ci hanno fatto un upgrade (molto apprezzato) a camera con bagno privato. Possibilità di cenare in struttura e lo consigliamo perché si mangia molto bene e a prezzi ottimi per essere in Islanda! Una cena per 2 persone intorno ai 40/50€! Colazione ottima e abbondante.
Parfait: accueil, logement, petit déjeuner, dîner. Tout était très bien.
Ужин был восхитительным, особенно баранина.

Siamo arrivati tardi, ma ci hanno fatto trovare le chiavi e tutte le informazioni più importanti, cosa molto apprezzata. La camera era accogliente, con una doccia ampia e confortevole. Colazione inclusa e ottima esperienza complessiva!
Ubicación excelente. Las hamburguesas del restaurante muy buenas

Nous avons séjourné une nuit dans cette guesthouse.
Notre chambre était situé au rez-de-chaussée et disposée d'une douche et toilette privatifs.
Chambre suffisamment grande, lits confortables et belle vue depuis les fenêtres.
De plus, on a pu assister devant la guesthouse a une magnifique aurore boréale 😍.
Très bon séjour.

Lieu entouré de moutons
Petits chalets en bois
Todo, muy lindo lugar

L'emplacement pour voir des aurores boréales !!

Le petit chalet très cocooning

Molto bella con lo sfondo del ghiacciaio

Ten domek to jakis ewenement, jeżeli chodzi o lokalizację. Jest cudowna! Macie stąd widok na 360° na wszystko, bez świateł miejskich. Udało nam się zobaczyć niesamowitą zorzę dwukrotnie nawet przez okna pokoju.
Dodatkowo super śniadanie, pyszne kruche, domowe ciasto i piernik. Dostępna gorąca woda i kawa dla gości. Super personel

Struttura accogliente. Staff gentilissimo. La struttura in generale era molto pulita e curata. La posizione ottima con una bella visuale al mattino. Conforme à la description, possibilité de dîner sur place à un prix acceptable dans le cadre islandais.
Petit dejeuner très correct.
Las vistas eran espectaculares. La habitacionuy confortable y espaciosa.
Accueil vraiment très agréable ; repas exquis et très bon petit déj. A recommander !

Es un sitio muy tranquilo y familiar. La carretera esta bastante bien aunque no esta asfaltada. El desayuno es pequeño pero esta bien, hacen un pan casero muy bueno. Si teneis suerte, la ubicación es buena para ver auroras.
Super Lage, schöne Zimmer und sehr gutes Frühstück

La cabaña era muy amplia, y limpia, solo le faltaba una cocinita, pero al coger la opción con desayuno, la verdad es que fue un acierto. Pena que la noche que estuvimos había mucha nube, porque habría sido un sitio espectacular donde ver auroras.

Emplacement , calme au milieu de la nature et des moutons, avec un superbe lever de soleil en cadeau face à la mer et le glacier.
Personnel discret efficace

Très bel emplacement avec vue sur les glaciers.
Calme, petit déjeuner très varié.

Esta muy chulo tanto la zona como la habitación, en una pequeña granja de ovejas, no pudimos cenar por llegar mas de las 20:00. El desayuno bien.
有看到極光，早餐不錯

Perto da estrada mas longe o suficiente para se ouvir apenas as ovelhas e o mar. Spot ideal para nascer do sol e por do sol. Com sorte vem se as auroras. Limpo, confortável, quente. Bonita sala de comer com janelas para a paisagem

Liegt nah an der Ringstraße, über eine leichte Gravelroad gut erreichbar. Die Betten waren sehr bequem und wir hatten ein kleines Waschbecken und eine Sitzecke mit im Zimmer. Das Frühstück war inklusive und völlig ausreichend. Alles war sehr sauber.
La habitación era muy espaciosa y la cama cómoda. El baño en suite también era muy cómodo. El desayuno estaba bueno.

Abbiamo prenotato questa guesthouse perché in zona era quella con le recensioni migliori ed ottimo rapporto qualità/prezzo.
Se mai dovessi tornare in Islanda, Nýpugarðar sarà sicuramente nel nostro itinerario!
Posizione idilliaca nella calma e natura più assoluta, personale accogliente e gentile, camere grandi, calde e pulite.
Abbiamo anche cenato qui e tutti i prodotti erano genuini. Colazione top.
Di notte abbiamo anche visto l’aurora boreale!
Complimenti

Nous avons tout aimé. Le cadre, le calme, l'accueil, les plats proposés au restaurant (nous avons pris un Burger gargantuesque), le petit déjeuner, la chambre, les lits,... Vraiment tout était parfait. Si nous revenons, c'est sûr que nous passerons par là.

receptioniste, een Spaanse van Gran Canaria die hier al 10 jaar elke zomer werkt, was heel vriendelijk, nam de tijd om alles goed uit te leggen, we hadden een van de vier huisjes in een rij, buiten het hoofdgebouw. heel ruim, nieuw, prachtig ingericht, parkeren voor de deur, vlak bij het hoofdgebouw, waar we 's avonds heel lekker gedineerd hebben, met ruim voldoende eten.
's ochtends ook een ujitstekend ontbijt. 3 km van de grote weg, dus echt rustig.
Posizione ottima e affascinante. Abbiamo cenato assaggiando il loro stufati di pecora, eccellente con rapporto qualità/ prezzo molto buono, buona anche la colazione.

El alojamiento fue el más barato de todo el viaje y estaba genial. Reservamos la habitación con baño privado en el piso superior.
Tiene lo básico, pero está limpio y es cómodo.
Reservamos la cena y todo estaba muy rico, y el precio era muy razonable. También puedes tomarte algo durante el día en la zona del desayuno sin problema. La recepcionista fue un encanto, habla español y nos contó muchas cosas de los Islandeses. Si vuelvo a esa zona, me volvería alojar ahí sin dudarlo. El desayuno es bastante variado.
Todo
Nos asignaron una habitación con baño privado pese a que habíamos reservado con baño compartido. Todo un detalle!!

Molto carini e ospitali. Avevamo necessità di uscire prima della colazione e loro hanno preparato per noi una colazione take-away per la mattina della partenza! La struttura è in un contesto assolutamente meraviglioso. La stanza ed il bagno erano essenziali ma molto ampi. La colazione molto varia e abbondante con prodotti davvero ottimi. Abbiamo anche cenato e abbiamo mangiato davvero bene con hamburger e carne di agnello della loro fattoria. Prezzo onestissimo per l’Islanda. Ottimo rapporto qualità prezzo. Camera con bagno privato, molto grande e tutto molto pulito. Zona in mezzo al verde, tra l’oceano e le montagne. La comida y el entorno
Tout était parfait, de l'emplacement à la chambre, du personnel hyper agréable au petit déjeuner, le dîner avec les produits de la ferme, et une vue incroyable. Merci !

Habitación y lavabo grandes y limpios, el desayuno incluido es ideal, pan recién hecho, embutidos, café y yogures de calidad. Además esta en una granja llena de ovejas alrededor y parece todo muy ideal, tiene vistas de naturaleza todo alrededor.

Lo mejor de este hotel es su ubicación, vistas privilegiadas al glaciar y una maravillosa tranquilidad. Desayuno muy bueno sobre todo el pan de limón casero. A mejorar las habitaciones con baño privado, solo añadir algunos detalles, como algún pequeño armario para dejar la ropa.
Ruhige Lage auf einer Schafsfarm. Eigenes Bad. Ausblick auf den Gletscher.

El alojamiento está ubicado en una zona preciosa y tranquila. La habitación era muy amplia y con baño privado lo que agradecimos enormemente. Aunque no tiene cocina sirven la cena a las 19h y estaba muy rico. El desayuno incluido ha sido muy variado y un gran punto a favor.
muy simpática la recepcionista..volveremos

La ubicación es perfecta, con vistas a varios glaciares y sensación de aislamiento total. Las cabañas son preciosas y la zona del desayuno está muy bien (además es bastante completo). En general nos ha encantado la experiencia, ojalá haber estado más tiempo.
Guest House a gestione familiare nel contesto di una fattoria, contesto splendido, cibo ottimo, colazione di ottima qualità.
Una struttura pulita e semplice, immersa nella natura. La cena e la collazione erano ottimi 👌

Die Lage ist ausgesprochen schön. Das Frühstück mit selbst gebackenem Brot war lecker.

Der tolle und spektakuläre Blick auf die Berge und Gletscherfelder war wunderbar. Gut war auch, dass ein gutes Frühstück im Preis inbegriffen war.

Consigliatissima per una sosta dopo la visita in zona dei ghiacciai del sud est. Struttura molto accogliente, camera spaziosa e letto comodissimo. Personale molto gentile.
